name: Jiangsu Zhangjiagang Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd
summary: Jiangsu Zhangjiagang Rural Commercial Bank Co., Ltd provides banking products and services in China. The company operates through four segments: Corporate Banking Business, Personal Banking Business, Treasury Business, and Other Businesses. The Corporate Banking Business segment provides services, including corporate loans, bill issuance, trade financing, corporate deposits and remittances, etc. to corporate customers. Its Personal Banking Business segment offers banking services, including retail loans, savings deposit business, credit card business, and remittance business to private customers.
